key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often nvidia-smi is queried for the top-bar value, and for the dropdown while it is open. The extension backs off to 30 seconds by itself while nvidia-smi keeps failing.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: What the top-bar label shows: VRAM usage as a percentage ("8%"), in gibibytes ("1.2/15.9 GiB"), or in mebibytes ("1262/16303 MiB").

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show a GPU icon next to the top-bar value.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: VRAM usage percentage at or above which the top-bar value turns yellow. 0 disables the warning colour.

key.name: critical-threshold
key.description: VRAM usage percentage at or above which the top-bar value turns red. 0 disables the critical colour.
